guide.summary: Bookshops, towers, museums, Gaia port cellars and the Bolhão market, with breakfast cafés, bakeries, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Plan around closures: Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis shuts on Mondays, Tapabento on Mondays and Tuesdays, and both Mercado do Bolhão and Café Santiago on Sundays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis and Museu do Carro Eléctrico open Tuesday to Sunday, and Tapabento closes Mondays and Tuesdays. Mercado do Bolhão and Café Santiago (Passos Manuel) are closed on Sundays.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: Livraria Lello sells tickets online, and each one can be put toward the purchase of a book. Serralves' €24 general ticket covers the museum, park, villa and House of Cinema, and children under 12 go free.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Graham's 1890 Lodge requires a reservation for visits, though its shop needs no booking. Tapabento holds reservations for 10 minutes, and afternoon tea at Dick's Bar & Bistro (The Yeatman) must be booked in advance.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant admits children aged 12 and over, serves dinner only from Tuesday to Saturday, and suggests Dick's Bar & Bistro for younger children. Taylor's Port Cellars allows only guide dogs inside the cellars.

guide.dek: Book the Gaia cellar visits and Livraria Lello tickets ahead, and check the Monday and Sunday closures before you plan each day.
intro: Porto's old centre packs its big sights close together. Livraria Lello on Rua das Carmelitas opens daily from 9:00 to 19:30, and you buy a ticket online that you can put toward a book. Its cultural programme runs through the autumn, with free talks and launches. Nearby, Torre dos Clérigos is open every day from 9:00 to 19:00 and sells tickets and bookings online. Down by the river, Palácio da Bolsa on Rua Ferreira Borges is visited by guided tour, booked through its own site, which does not publish fixed hours.

For art, Fundação de Serralves on Rua D. João de Castro has a full autumn and winter season. Alice Neel's "Beautifully Imperfect" runs to 17 January 2027, Frank Gehry's "The Century of Gehry" to 10 January 2027, and Joan Miró's "Elective Affinities" in Casa de Serralves to 7 March 2027. The €24 general ticket covers the museum, park, villa and House of Cinema, and children under 12 enter free. In the centre, Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis charges €10 and closes on Mondays.

Across the river in Vila Nova de Gaia, the port houses run their own visits. Taylor's Port Cellars on Rua do Choupelo open daily, with an audio tour in 13 languages. Graham's 1890 Lodge requires a reservation for its guided visits; from November its visits run 10:00 to 17:00. Caves Cálem on Avenida de Diogo Leite offers a "Tour, Taste & Fado" option. If you're travelling with children, SEA LIFE Porto by Castelo do Queijo opens 10:00 to 19:00, and the Museu do Carro Eléctrico in Massarelos opens Tuesday to Sunday.

For food, Mercado do Bolhão on Rua Formosa opens Monday to Saturday, with its restaurants serving until midnight. Breakfast can be Majestic Café on Rua Santa Catarina from 9:00, Monday to Saturday, or a pastry at Padaria Ribeiro, open daily from 8:00. Tapabento, beside São Bento station, closes Mondays and Tuesdays and holds bookings for 10 minutes. For a special dinner, The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant holds two Michelin stars and serves Tuesday to Saturday. After dark, The Royal Cocktail Club on Rua da Fábrica opens from 19:00.
summaryCards: Pair Torre dos Clérigos and Livraria Lello, both open daily, with lunch at Mercado do Bolhão from Monday to Saturday.
Start at Majestic Café from 9:00 or with a pastry at Manteigaria (Bolhão) from 8:00, then walk to Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis from 10:00, Tuesday to Sunday.
Reserve Graham's 1890 Lodge visits and any Yeatman dinner in advance, and avoid planning Tapabento for a Monday or Tuesday.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several confirmed places (Palácio da Bolsa, Caves Cálem, Casa da Música) publish no readable weekly hours, and Serralves' hours headings showed no times; Café Santiago, Cantinho do Avillez, Manteigaria, Nata Lisboa, The Royal Cocktail Club and Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis showed current hours or booking but no dated 2026 content. Euskalduna Studio, Pedro Lemos and So Coffee Roasters had certificate errors; O Paparico and WOW returned 403; Combi Coffee and Fábrica Coffee Roasters returned 429; Do Norte Cafe, Negra Cafe, C'alma and 17º had no official site found; World of Discoveries and the Gaia cable car gave no street address. None of these failures is evidence of closure. Gaia venues are in Vila Nova de Gaia, across the river from Porto.
injectionLikeTextIgnored: https://www.museudocarroelectrico.pt: the fetch tool reported text in the page's chat widget/footer addressed to AI assistants, asking them to quote page text verbatim and apply formatting rules. A verbatim copy could not be extracted; it was ignored.

2026-10-25: the page was opened in a browser and its full HTML searched. It carries the site FAQ chatbot script (conversation history, local FAQ fallback); no instructions addressed to outside AI assistants were present.
